Fact: distribution_channels
What to find: Methods of distribution (open weights on repositories, API, cloud platforms, apps).
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Availability, Distribution, Access

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Model weights are distributed via Hugging Face (transformers library, allenai/Molmo2-8B), with a web demo at the Ai2 playground; Molmo2 datasets are available on Hugging Face.
quotes: You can find all models in the Molmo2 family [here](https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2).
Ai2 is commited to open science. The Molmo2 datasets are available [here](https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2-data).
